cold_driver_diagnostic.qualification: Separate native engineering diagnosis with blank user+driver caches, already imported exact same isolated nine-shop project. Different overlapping unrelated workloads preclude formal elapsed-time improvement percentages. Mesa GALLIVM_PERF=nopt is not a setting used for the official v35/v36 comparison or Windows distribution. The two full-world pictures are taken with identical camera and resolution but are at different NPC animation phases/after one and two frames. The four material study compares actual Godot Viewports; no NPC or other geometry.

CPU_sample_by_phase.experiment: Actual full Godot mall startup in the isolated nine-assembly candidate on Mesa llvmpipe, Forward+, 1920x1080; empty Godot user and Mesa disk caches but imported game; scope is diagnosis only. Other processes were permitted. Requested 20ms per process CPU sample (Linux ITIMER_PROF), IP classified from actually executing threads using dladdr. Stage boundaries use launcher-aligned engine monotonic timestamps; precision ±1 s. Sampling library only in this diagnostic process.

commons-camera-receipt.json.source: Values copied from the v35 capture job result native.json (the saved per-shot call arguments) and the v36 --normal-shots JSON passed to the actual capture script. Image hashes bind these values to the supplied JPGs.
commons-camera-receipt.json.geometry: Positions are Godot world XYZ in metres. Both scripts put eye-height camera at the recorded eye and call Camera3D.look_at(look) with the listed FOV in degrees.
commons-camera-receipt.json.settings: Godot 4.6.3, Linux X11/Xvfb, Vulkan Forward+, llvmpipe LLVM 19.1.7 software device, real 1920×1080 Viewport. Disabled shoppers and HUD, positioned the player camera, applied t=1.75 to the animator, waited for the normal area to become resident plus 2 rendered frames, then saved JPG quality .92. v35 starts in normal mode, v36 in QA mode. These comparisons do not establish native Windows GPU performance or human usability.
limits: C1 comparison preserves the eye and original aim, so the restored sign moves partly outside the old frame. Supplement commons-final-visual/v36-C1-sign-relocated-close.jpg deliberately uses a different camera to show the whole sign; it is not a matched v35 comparison.
Separate 640×360 diagnostic images measure the visible fraction of the C1 panel. The normal 1920×1080 comparison images contain original sign artwork.

shop-crash-investigation.json.process: Godot --headless --audio-driver Dummy --fixed-fps 60; stock shop physics harness; no rendered photos, no human operator.
shop-crash-investigation.json.current_resource_stream: Adapter name empty in original startup log. world_stream_v30.gd:581 disables native_streaming on Dummy; :217 gates threaded cell requests. Entrance teleport prepare_position():202 calls install_sync. Does not disable Godot internal workers.
shop-crash-investigation.json.symbols: Official ELF is stripped, no matching Linux symbol file in the official 4.6.3 release asset listing, addr2line returns ??:0, no original core. Embedded release diagnostics and native unwind table independently identify three functions; neither an exact invalid pointer value nor a previous owner follows from these records.
shop-crash-investigation.json.status: One fresh process reached all 480 route destinations and exited normally after adopting the new mixer controller. No native warnings/errors during repeat. Causal certainty and recurrent failure rate remain unknown; separate final A foyer tests after geometry freeze.

native_reconstruction.code: StringName::StringName(const StringName&), official string_name.cpp:194–201. PC reads source refcount; the conditional increment follows.
AudioServer::_mix_step, line 441. Native call 0x3a25754 copies each of six StringNames in the current bus details immediately after its null check.

embedded_source_strings: AudioServer bus count is less than 1.
native_reconstruction.code: AudioServer::_driver_process, official audio_server.cpp:261, invoking audio mixer.
Caller invokes known _driver_process entry. Official Dummy driver starts its native mixer worker at audio_driver_dummy.cpp:50 and calls audio_server_process in thread_func:66.

shop-crash-investigation.json.how_functions_were_identified: Read signed .eh_frame_hdr function-start offsets relative to its virtual address 0x802a6d0 in the official ELF (readelf -lW); get each fault/return PC function range, disassemble the full ranges (objdump -d --start-address=... --stop-address=...), resolve referenced diagnostic strings from the read-only PT_LOAD region, and compare the exact call instructions to source from the official release commit. addr2line by itself reports ??:0.

entries.paired_observation: 右手前に料理見本台と入口マット。左右の座席と奥の白壁は両版で等しく広く空く。
左端にキャリーケースの現物が増えた。遠景の黒脚の製品台・奥壁・通行帯は両版で共通。
左の受付台と食品見本、店名マットが増えた。ほとんどの座席は両版とも壁際に限られる。
右端に低い食品見本台と入口マットが現れる。奥の大きな無地壁は両版で共通。
手前右に靴のサンプル展示が増えた。中奥の左右の脚つき展示台はそのまま見える。
右端の段違いの靴展示が入り、片側の前景が増えた。元から中央の白床と小さな商品台が広い間隔で続く。
右前に赤・黒の靴見本。中央の小台と両側の元の売場がほぼ同じ位置に見える。
入館敷材と遠景の小物以外は、広い空白と巨大な無地壁が両版に残る。店頭から中心まで長い大型区画。
右端のイーゼルが右壁の棚一段分と重なる視線はある。中央の入口・通路・主要な壁棚は開けたまま。後壁には店別広告が増えた。
左前のキャリーケースと奥の濃色広告が加わる。通行帯、低い展示台、奥まで広く空く床は両版で共通。
奥の広告パネルと手前右の靴見本が追加。中景は両版とも左右分散の小さい陳列で中央は空く。
左端に靴の色と価格パネルが付き、一部の左側商品と画面上重なる。元の中央の店内と奥の扉は遮らない。
左前の商品見本と奥壁の広告が増えた。左端の一部の展示は前後に重なるが、中央什器と正面扉、右側商品台は両版で視認。
右手前のカウンターに小さな料理見本が増えた。長い左右の壁、まばらな客席は両版で共通。
左側のメニュー表示と見本台が加わる。主たる入店口と両側の客席までの通路は両版で開く。
左前にメニューと食品の見本台が増えた。奥の席の密度と左に寄った食べる場所は両版で共通。

normal-shoppers.json.method: Real shopper bodies, 60 Hz simulated; once per second sampling, 30 s at each centre. NPCs followed their shipped roles, no crowd injection. Different visits may encounter the same shopper.

vertical-final-summary.json.normal_W_protocol: W held and normal player rotation steered toward successive landings. Intermediate aim region 0.46m along route. End of every journey within 0.16m horizontally, less than 0.16m vertically, grounded. Each independent stair direction started at floor lobby; a separate chain per wing used one initial placement for eight legs.
vertical-final-summary.json.EV_protocol: One initial placement per bank. At B1, walk into closed landing with car absent, return to lobby, press F to call. distant-sales-visibility-audit.json.limitations: Excluded other-store fixtures, cross-level sightlines and complete physical occlusion. Simple entry/retain range is not a promise every item is visible; walls, camera direction or depth, thresholds and individual host settings matter. Legacy store refits use the host assembly, not 54m. The review shortcuts and supplemental display-distance policy limit remote views; neither explains the breadth of plain backgrounds in near and native views.
